titulo: Three ways to split the dishes
caption:
Three ways to split the dishes

I used to say I'll do it all and sigh through the dishes. Then I started saying you wash, I dry.

Splitting a chore out loud keeps it from turning into a quiet scoreboard, and it usually goes faster.

For whoever splits the chore out loud.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a shelf of jars and a brick-red figure that asks who's on dishes? in each of three labeled scenes. The dodge: a teal figure says not it! and looks away. The martyr: a brown figure squints, trembles and says I'll do it all. while the red one looks down. The split: an ink-black figure tilts its head and says you wash, I dry., and both figures have happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of sharing chores. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
